:::{#exm-harmonic-mean}
#### Harmonic mean of 0.5 and 1

By @def-harmonic-mean:

$$
\ba
H(0.5, 1)
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{0.5} + \frac{1}{1}}
&& \text{(definition of } H \text{)} \\
&= \frac{2}{2 + 1}
&& \text{(take each reciprocal)} \\
&= \frac{2}{3}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&\approx 0.667
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

The ordinary average of 0.5 and 1 is 0.75;
the harmonic mean sits closer to the smaller number.

:::
